positioning.serviceFamily: AI Apps & Agents as a Service
positioning.summary: Hosted Foundry agent pattern that separates privileged reasoning from untrusted public-web research through a strict JSON isolation contract.

tools.description: Delegates public-web research to an isolated read-only worker and returns validated claims, citations, budget usage, and guardrail evidence.

query.description: A minimized public research question. Must not include secrets, customer data, internal URLs, private file content, or credentials.

allowed_domains.description: Optional comma-separated public hostnames that citations must come from. Operator configured allowlists can only be narrowed, not widened.

max_iterations.description: Maximum search/read refinement rounds for the isolated worker.

samplePayload.query: Research current Microsoft Learn guidance for Azure AI Foundry agents. Include citations.

governance.dataBoundary: The privileged main agent never reads raw web pages. Public-web content is read only by a sanitized, unprivileged worker/subagent, and only validated claims/citations cross back through the findings contract.
governance.authModel: Hosted Foundry agent uses Microsoft Entra identity through Foundry/Azure credentials. Research tasks and findings must not carry secrets or credentials.
allowedOutbound: public HTTPS hosts inside configured allowlists
DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API for direct HTTP mode

evidence.name: architecture and contract review
evidence.summary: README, ARCHITECTURE-GUIDE, isolation_contracts.py, and tests define the web isolation invariant, URL validation, injection scanning, allowlist narrowing, citation provenance, and action gate.

findings.finding: No live hosted runtime health record is bundled in the AAPAAS evidence snapshot yet. Keep as candidate until deployed endpoint and sample invocation evidence are captured.

promotionRules: Must capture deployed Foundry hosted-agent runtime health before service promotion.
Must capture a sample invocation using allowed public sources before customer-facing promotion.
Must document operator egress allowlist ownership and default provider mode for each deployment.
Must remain classified as a governed AgentPack, not a local-only personal tool.
